THREE MORE FROM THE STUDY

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

The whole route.

  1. Apply or request. A capture professional applies with their device and practice work. A space owner asks for a managed walkthrough. Neither form creates an account or takes payment.
  2. Assessment, free. We review the device, the software and a practice capture, or we scope the space and quote it. Applying costs nothing and promises no jobs, leads or earnings.
  3. Pay to use Veylet. After approval an operator pays for the app and system, for their own clients. The first hosting term we propose is three months, with optional extension. Scope, price and timing follow an agreed quote.
  4. Capture, then hand off. The space is captured and reconstructed. The operator previews it on their account, then creates an unlisted handoff link for the client. The client needs no account, and the operator can revoke the link at any time.

Until checkout is proven, payment is invoiced rather than taken on this site. This page does not take cards and there is no public tour gallery.

ANSWERS

Before you write.

Does applying create an account or take payment?

No. Apply and request do not create an account and take no payment. The first time you sign in with an email address, that sign-in creates an email account — it is not operator approval, not payment, and not a client tour.

Can I get a walkthrough without the capture app?

Yes. Request a walkthrough. Managed clients do not need Veylet Capture installed.

How do I become a capture operator?

Apply. We assess device, software and a practice capture. After approval you pay to use the app and system. No jobs, leads or earnings promise.
